claims.type: instrument hardening (new counter for the no-git path; surgical)
claims.surface: V70-6: `reports/round-69/accept-d.py`'s selftest seeds its do-nothing fixture from `git show` and silently falls back to the live SKILL.md when .git is absent, so an exported tree (git archive) reports a false red (DO-NOTHING FIXTURE: PASS (unexpected), SELFTEST 1/2, exit 1) — indistinguishable from a genuine failure. A NEW counter `reports/round-71/accept-d.py` imports the frozen counter and adds a declared no-git path: when .git is absent, it prints `SELFTEST: COULD-NOT-EVALUATE (no git)` and exits 2; when .git is present it runs the frozen selftest unchanged (SELFTEST: 2/2, exit 0). The frozen round-69 counter bytes are unchanged.
claims.before: `python3 -B reports/round-69/accept-d.py --selftest` inside a copy of the repo tree WITHOUT .git prints DO-NOTHING FIXTURE: PASS (unexpected) / SELFTEST: 1/2 and exits 1 (V70-6 recorded on a git archive of 453676a2); the frozen counter has no indistinguishable-red guard.
claims.after: `python3 -B reports/round-71/accept-d.py --selftest` in the repo (with .git) prints SELFTEST: 2/2 and exits 0; the same command in a .git-less copy of the tree prints `SELFTEST: COULD-NOT-EVALUATE (no git)` and exits 2; the frozen counter's data predicate `python3 -B reports/round-69/accept-d.py --root .` still prints ACCEPT-D-69: PASS legs=8/8 exit 0.
